quests.title: The Homebound Moon

dialogue.t: Is it just Paimon, or do you smell something yummy too?
Columbina's having a feast for one!
{NICKNAME}, Paimon...
Looks like someone's enjoying herself...
Would you like to try some as well?
We don't usually see you eating here! Did you go out just to buy it?
Lauma gave it to me.
Wow, she sure takes good care of you, huh?
On the condition that I don't leave.
Wait, what!? Isn't that just a bribe so you'll accept house arrest? And a cheap one, at that!
She also brought me some interesting books and exquisitely made toys...
Um, now it sounds more like a mother going out on a business trip and the kid she's leaving at home...
She just told me not to go out for the time being, and to be especially sure to avoid the Frostmoon Scions.
I asked the animals who came to deliver my meals, but Lauma had instructed them to remain silent, and so they did.
Uh, that's...
If I had to guess, she is preparing something that has to do with me.
Worry not. I have never considered staying here boring in the first place. The food is good, and much to my liking. Not going out is fine with me.
And if the Scions are indeed preparing for something... Well, all the more reason not to interrupt them.

dialogue.sit: Want us to go ask around?

dialogue.t: Yeah. Paimon's kinda curious now, too.
You can... but you should be prepared.
She likely knows you'll come to see me, so she may not tell you anything at all.
You wanna renovate the statue of Kuutar!?
Precisely so.
No longer is she the wingless Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar who could only gaze at the moon beyond the skies in solitude.
We witnessed her unfurling her wings, and know she has regained the freedom to live.
As such, it is only right that the statue, too, be restored.
That does sound like a good idea!

dialogue.sit: Have you told the other Frostmoon Scions about this?

dialogue.t: That I have. I spoke to them of the Moon Goddess's sacrifice, and her return...
And of how we stood against the force that pollutes this world with the guidance of that gentle light.
Everyone was delighted to hear of her return, so I took the opportunity to convey Columbina's thoughts to them...
That she wants to see us as family, and would like us to do the same for her.
The Lady Moon Goddess...
Would we... not be overstepping by regarding her as family?
I believe that this is what Columbina genuinely wishes for.
(I can't believe the Lady Moonchanter referred to our Moon Goddess by her first name!)
Perhaps you may all yet recall the words I spoke not long ago.
"The road shall be paved with truth, and we shall pave it ourselves."
I will not ask all of you to make the same choice as I, but I do have words I would like to share with you this day.
"If we wish to invite the moonlight in to stay, we must first open doors that once were tightly shut."
...That is what happened. Considering the situation over the past few days, things seem to have gone better than I thought they might have.
Lady Lauma. A new batch of stone has arrived at the warehouse.
Understood. I'll be right over.
Could you keep what I said, including what you've seen, a secret from Columbina — at least for now? I'd like this to be a surprise.
Paimon knows you mean well, but seriously, you sure do love your surprises... You, and your Moon Goddess...
Hey, Lauma, about Paimon's hush money... Er, Paimon meant to say, we don't happen to have any spare Feast of the Moon servings today, do we?
That we do. Come, let me prepare some for you. Oh, and one more thing...
Ah, you're back.
Guess what, Columbina? You were right, Lauma didn't tell us a thing!
So we'll be keeping you company over the next few days. You just sit tight and keep those expectations high!
Expectations for... what exactly?
Ack...! Oh! Uh, nothing! We don't know a thing, honest!
Hehe... Very well, then. I look forward to spending the next few days with you.
Ooh, here comes our food... Wait a minute. Where's the grub?
It says, "The time has come." Do you know what that means?
Ohhhhh, Paimon gets it now.
Yes?

dialogue.sit: You usually wear a blindfold, don't you?

dialogue.t: Yes. What of it?
But you can use kuuvahki to observe the outside world even so, right?
That's right. If anything, I sense things more clearly this way.
Then, uh, could we ask you to deliberately not sense any changes outside for the time being?
So that this can be a "pleasant surprise"?
...Sounds like you've already guessed what this is about...
Alright. I see. In that case, would you take my hand?
Here we are.

dialogue.sit: You can open your eyes now.

dialogue.t: (She really did open her eyes!)
It's beautiful...
This pair of wings makes it look all the more complete.
This is a gift we Frostmoon Scions would like to give you, Columbina.
To celebrate our goddess who can now fly free, whose fingers can at last touch the place she calls "home."
...The me from before would only be reminded of the confusion I felt upon being born whenever I looked upon this statue.
But now, what I feel is the warmth of a "home."
Perhaps, like this statue, I have chosen to stay here even though I now have wings.
...Thank you all.
We do have another gift prepared, but you'll have to walk with me a bit farther.
Huh? There's another surprise?
My fellow Scions and I have organized a simple welcome banquet in the forest.
From now on, this will be your home as well, Columbina.
Whenever you grow homesick, please, feel free to remain here and enjoy our hospitality, meager though it may be.
Sure. I will.

dialogue.sit: Well, what do you know? The moon's up.

dialogue.t: Let's go, then.
It is my hope that every night may be as wonderful as that Moon-Prayer Night.
Welcome home, Columbina.

quests.description: Columbina is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall…
